title: Genie Agents enhancements and bug fixes
body:
* **Connect to external tools (Beta)**: A Genie Agent can now search and take actions in external tools like Google Drive and Microsoft 365 through MCP connectors. See [Connect a Genie Agent to external tools and sources](/aws/en/genie-agents/external-tools).
* **Automatic content search on attached volumes (Beta)**: When you attach a volume to a Genie Agent, Databricks now automatically enables content search for it. See [How content search works](/aws/en/genie-agents/volumes#content-search).
* **Automatic volume sync (Beta)**: Content search now stays in sync with attached volumes automatically. When you add, change, or remove files, Databricks updates the index without any manual step. See [How content search works](/aws/en/genie-agents/volumes#content-search).
* **Volumes from restricted catalogs (Beta)**: You can now attach a volume as a source for a Genie Agent even when the volume's catalog isn't accessible from the agent's workspace by default, such as a catalog that is [bound to specific workspaces](/aws/en/data-governance/unity-catalog/access-control/workspace-catalog-binding). See [Attach volumes to a Genie Agent](/aws/en/genie-agents/volumes#attach-volumes).
* **File upload fix**: Fixed a bug where uploading a file to a Genie Agent through Genie One created duplicate conversations.
* **Deletion warning for sources and instructions**: Deleting sources or instructions from a Genie Agent now asks you to confirm to prevent accidental deletions.
* **Column display name fix**: Fixed a bug where Genie Code did not update column display names in a Genie Agent.
